reason: The 10-K contains a market opportunity section that references third-party research (Financial Health Network, PYMNTS) stating approximately 185 million Americans are 'financially coping or vulnerable' and approximately $43 billion in annual fees for basic checking services, plus over $225 billion in annual fees and interest for short-term credit. However, these figures are attributed to external research organizations (FHN, PYMNTS) rather than being company-disclosed TAM estimates. The company states 'we estimate to be approximately 185 million Americans' but this estimate is derived from third-party FHN data, not company-originated TAM disclosure. No company-disclosed TAM figure from Dave Inc. itself was found in the filing.
